pages.text: Upgrade an $(item)Elytra$() with a $(item)Hang Glider$() and a $(item)Phantom Membrane$() at a smithing table. Wear it on your chest and fall to start flying: thermals lift you exactly like they lift the glider.
Smithing table: membrane as template, elytra as base, glider as addition. The wings keep the glider's colour and repaint at a paint can.
